name: Economic
low: Right — free markets, low taxes, privatization
high: Left — higher taxes, government services, redistribution
description: Measures views on the economy, from free-market capitalism to government-driven socialism. Values range -2 (market) to +2 (state).

name: Social
low: Libertarian — individual freedom, minimal state control
high: Authoritarian — law and order, strict rules, strong state control
description: Measures attitudes toward social authority and civil liberties. Values range -2 (libertarian) to +2 (authoritarian).

name: Foreign Policy
low: Non-interventionist — diplomacy first, avoid foreign wars
high: Interventionist — military action, global influence, active abroad
description: Measures views about foreign policy engagement. Values range -2 (non-intervention) to +2 (intervention).
